# 🔮 SkyrimNet-OStim Integration 🔥

## Overview

This integration mod creates a powerful bridge between **SkyrimNet** AI framework and **OStim** adult framework for Skyrim, enabling natural language control over intimate encounters. Simply chat with NPCs and the AI will intelligently interpret your dialogue to initiate, modify, or end intimate scenes! 🗣️💬

> ⚠️ **When you see Skyrim message boxes NEVER use mouse to answer them, it will make sometimes your camera to fly away, it is known issue without known solution. Use keyboard hotkeys to select confirmation option.**

> 📝 **NOTE**: This integration does NOT alter the main SkyrimNet prompt to make NPCs more sexually forward or explicit. NPCs will maintain their established personalities and relationship boundaries. The mod simply adds capabilities for the AI to understand and interact with OStim functionality when appropriate within character.

## ✨ Features

- **📚 Available Actions**
- **⚙️ Configuration Settings**
- **🎭 Intents, Roles, Scenes & Threads**
- **⏳ Thread Phases**
- **👀 Spectators System**
- **🧠 AI Encounter Evaluations**
- **📝 Scene Descriptions**
- **💬 Confirmation Messages**
- **💦 OCum Integration** - Enhances AI awareness with fluid overlays and generates more immersive climax narratives.

### Added

- **Transient mid-scene reactions & live physical transition narration** — Replaced persistent mid-scene `tton_event` clutter with a zero-persistence transient reaction pipeline (`DispatchTransientReaction`, `ostimnet_transient_cue` decorator, and `0805_ostim_transient_cue.prompt`):
- **Chronological encounter timeline & consolidated `sex_stop` summary** — Tracks settled scenes, pace shifts, mid-scene joiners, dynamic/role shifts, pullouts, climaxes, virginity milestones, and spectators across thread continuations, summarizing the completed encounter into a concise past-tense record (`ostimnet_summarize_encounter.prompt`) attached to the persistent `sex_stop` event.
- **Per-thread physical trait capture for encounter summaries** — Lazily snapshots non-average physical trait tiers from `BodyLanguage.dll` while actors are undressed during active sexual scenes so notable outlier traits remain available to `ostimnet_summarize_encounter.prompt` after actors redress.

### Changed

- **Deduplicated ongoing scene description in dialogue prompts** — `0201_ostim_scenes.prompt` now omits the raw scene description for the speaking NPC's own active sexual scene (preserving it for bystanders, spectators, non-sexual scenes, and other concurrent scenes) while `0502_sex.prompt` renders it once at high recency beside the voice modifier.
- **Cleaned up superseded trigger YAMLs** — Removed 6 triggers (`tton_sex_position_change`, `tton_sex_pace_change`, `tton_sex_climax`, `tton_partner_near_edge`, `tton_sex_interrupted`, `tton_action_decline`) now handled directly by the C++ transient reaction pipeline.
- **Animation descriptions & metadata** — Expanded custom scene descriptions in `Billyy.json`.
